integration_status: Persisted policy and executable local pre-render/publication guards; live n8n/provider integration NOT_DEPLOYED.

anatomy_orientation.initial_alignment: Rigid rotation/translation/uniform scale supported by anatomy; record transformations and lock orientation

structure_check.raw_gate_a: Compare actual source only; record NOT_RUN / NOT_RECERTIFIED when not rerun

material.other_finishes: Resolve SKU material from shared Core finish library; do not force all earring SKUs to Champagne Rose
cleanup_rules: structure lock is not metal RGB lock
clean coherent polished reflections without seams or plastic flatness
preserve physical dark reflections and curvature
scope explicit; no automatic full-metal retouch
material.cleanup_entry_order: Create map -> assess need -> choose A/B/C before any edit entrypoint.

internal_markings.target: continuous clean natural polished metal, no stamp ghost, retain locked finish

routes.UNCERTAIN: record ambiguity and resolve view classification before generation

reconstruction.inference: minimum simple continuation of visible construction; no decorative features, added stones, holes or new mechanisms
reconstruction.mandatory_precondition: All four locks: MACRO_IDENTITY_LOCK, MICRO_SETTING_LOCK, CLOSURE_LOCK, FRONT_CAMERA_LOCK. Source-bound hard shape references required where applicable. Additionally SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY_GATE and GENERATIVE_AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY must authorize exact source/locks/target before rendering.
reconstruction.postcondition: MACRO_IDENTITY_CHECK, MICRO_SETTING_CHECK, CLOSURE_GEOMETRY_CHECK, FRONT_CAMERA_CHECK, VIEW_AWARE_SKU_CHECK must all PASS before downstream production.

view_routing.role_change: No automatic role reassignment or overwrite of existing locked views

angle_language.FRONT_HERO: upright straight/front-facing, minimum perspective, readable front stones
angle_language.ANGLED_PRESENTATION: controlled mild horizontal yaw, readable stone face plus depth/side thickness; same camera height/pitch/roll/lens family

view_aware_sku_check.unknown_visible_feature: REVIEW with precise unresolved feature; do not fabricate certainty

finish_consistency.compare: both presentations against locked material identity and approved per-SKU appearance

pair_alignment.raster_tolerance: Report actual measured deltas and measurement uncertainty; do not silently round to zero. IMG5751 human-accepted409/408 and0.5px center is a specific canonical example, not blanket authorization for larger mismatches.
pair_alignment.transforms: Common pair uniform scale and x/y placement; small spacing correction only if required before final lock

final_framing.bbox: joint tight axis-aligned visible product bbox of both views, shadows excluded; exclusive right/bottom coords
final_framing.grid_collection: Smaller display only in website/UI; do not shrink catalog master for grid purposes
final_framing.quality_workflow: highest-quality locked individual assets -> native-quality composition -> ONE final high-quality common uniform resampling ->1200PNG

premium_qa.pass: commercially strong stone/metal readability; record expected downsampling limits and visible limitations honestly
premium_qa.resampling_failure_route: rebuild only from locked highest-quality individual assets with one final resampling; keep accepted composition; no regeneration

human_review.golden_reference: Separate explicit human designation; not automatic with final approval

final_export.if_locked_final_png_exists: Byte-identical copy under final filename; zero extra resampling

provenance_required: precise mask review decision if route C
loading_rule: Future earring tasks must load ACTIVE_EARRING_STANDARD.json, verify standard status ACTIVE/version/hash, then this spec BEFORE planning. Historical/redirected rules are not active production inputs.

metal_cleanup_routing.map_creation: Create a source-hash-bound full-canvas surface proposal before any approval check. Record metal, stones/settings, mechanisms, openings/background and unresolved material, plus disjoint SAFE/UNCERTAIN/PROTECTED regions. Unknown pixels remain uncertain; no invented exact segmentation.
metal_cleanup_routing.map_geometry: Record exact coordinate frame and transforms; source-coordinate map creation may precede final catalog orientation lock. Any subsequent transform invalidates or must identically transform/reverify the map. This does not grant edit approval.

A.name: CLEANUP_NOT_REQUIRED
A.criteria: Documented commercial-cleanliness review finds no cleanup need; only locked finish/application needed. No mandatory cleanup.
A.note: Does not waive safe finish masking, marking-removal review, structure checks or Gate F.

B.name: CLEANUP_AUTO_SAFE
B.criteria: Source-bound map and localized diagnosis verified; sufficient safe edit domain; no risk to stones, settings, silhouette, mechanisms, openings or protected structure; exact non-edit-domain preservation can be checked.
B.continue: Only after actual cleanup and Gate M PASS; route eligibility is not PASS.

C.name: MASK_REVIEW_REQUIRED
C.criteria: Editable metal domain or cleanup diagnosis is ambiguous, or safety evidence is insufficient.
C.human_approval_applies_to: Exact generated map digest and explicit proposed scope; no approval can make unresolved unsafe pixels automatically safe.

metal_cleanup_routing.gate_policy: Map/routing review does not run or pass Gate M. Route A uses explicit skip. B/C actual edits retain exact structure, protected RGB, continuity and material-depth checks. RAW_GATE_A remains separate from VIEW_AWARE_SKU_CHECK.
metal_cleanup_routing.legacy_module_binding: GLEOR_METAL_CLEANUP_AGENT_V1 v1.3.0 supplies cleanup invariants. Its global_surface.execute human-only entry guard must not be used for map creation or routing. Do not fabricate human approval for auto-safe execution. For current Route C stop after real review artifacts.

Mandatory source-bound macro inspection and identity lock before every earring reconstruction; macro recheck before pair composition.
Evidence-aware macro lock; only materially unsupported target-visible invention causes BLOCKING_AMBIGUITY. Mandatory inspection preserved.
Mandatory focal stone micro setting inspection/lock before reconstruction and micro setting check after; existing macro evidence-aware gate retained.
Mandatory source-patch hard shape authority, closure lock and frontal camera lock; five checks gate all downstream operations.
Explicitly include structure/macro/micro inspection stages in all reconstruction gate sequences; preserve closure/camera hard gates.

changed_rules: all-metal appearance scope with immutable geometry
revision_history.compatibility: Existing micro/closure/camera locks remain byte-identical. Existing structural failures retained; no RAW_GATE_A promotion. No superseded rules reactivated.

Macro/micro locks and finish profile unchanged. Source ambiguity alone not blocked. Only unsupported target-visible identity blocks. Existing retry budget not reset; no superseded framing reactivated.

required_evidence: native and enlarged stone crops for every visible stone-bearing region
per-field observation and source crop binding
measured values with uncertainty where resolvable
macro_identity_hard_gate.lock_success: Mandatory inspection and source-bound lock artifact. VERIFIED and PARTIAL_SOURCE_AMBIGUITY may proceed when each target-visible identity-critical field has source-supported safe constraints. Lock existence alone never authorizes generation; target-view sufficiency is independently mandatory.
macro_identity_hard_gate.incomplete_lock: Only BLOCKING_AMBIGUITY blocks reconstruction after mandatory artifact/integrity checks. Numerical ambiguity alone does not block.
macro_identity_hard_gate.changed_or_unverified_locked_feature: Any change to VERIFIED visible constraints: MACRO_IDENTITY_FAIL -> reject -> no pair composition. SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS fields are HUMAN_REVIEW, neither automatic PASS nor FAIL.
macro_identity_hard_gate.hidden_surfaces: Only unseen surfaces may be conservatively inferred; never reinterpret visible Product Truth. Natural camera occlusion must be documented and is not itself a failure.
macro_identity_hard_gate.ambiguity_test: Does the target require inventing a materially different visible SKU feature? If no, proceed using strongest source-supported constraints. If yes and no safe constraint exists, BLOCKING_AMBIGUITY.
macro_identity_hard_gate.row_policy: Use source-row crop as topology authority: visible row length, diameter family, spacing rhythm, termination, setting width and repeated prong language. Never invent numeric count or use a generic jewelry pattern.
macro_identity_hard_gate.gallery_policy: Separate openings, bridges, distribution and mechanism/pin relationships are hard constraints. Never merge multiple openings into a long cavity.

micro_setting_hard_gate.scope: Every earring presentation reconstruction with visible focal stone/setting
micro_setting_hard_gate.applicability: Record APPLICABLE or evidence-backed NOT_APPLICABLE; never silently omit
micro_setting_hard_gate.precondition: PRESENTATION_RECONSTRUCTION = NOT_ALLOWED until source-bound MICRO_SETTING_LOCK exists for applicable SKU, all fields recorded with evidence states and safe visible constraints. Source ambiguity cannot authorize reinterpretation.
evidence_requirements: visible contour authority separate from hidden 3D uncertainty
micro_setting_hard_gate.inference: Hidden surface continuation only. Visible holders, support relationship and rail connections cannot be reinterpreted. No generic setting substitution.
micro_setting_hard_gate.pass_requires: Positive source-supported comparison for each target-visible locked feature; unavailable evidence is not a fabricated PASS. Natural occlusion documented.
micro_setting_hard_gate.fail_action: Reject immediately; no Gate M, Gate F, pair composition, framing or Premium QA.
micro_setting_hard_gate.automation_limit: Guard validates records/hashes/status only; visual inspection is required and is not automated metrology.

hard_shape_reconstruction_gate.precondition: All four source-bound lock artifacts must exist and match source hash. Nonapplicable settings/hardware require evidence-backed NOT_APPLICABLE artifacts.
hard_shape_reconstruction_gate.shape_authority: Unretouched source patches with coordinates and hashes; visible contour/thickness family, width relationships, contact topology, overlaps and attachments are non-negotiable. Descriptive substitutes cannot override source pixels.

front_camera.perspective: Minimum; no visible residual three-quarter yaw
front_camera.axis: Upright vertical front rail and stone axis
front_camera.rear_loop: May be naturally occluded behind front rail
front_camera.studio: Neutral white soft studio, same material family

hard_shape_reconstruction_gate.postcondition: All five checks must PASS for downstream work; any FAIL immediately rejects and prohibits Gate M, Gate F, composition, framing and Premium QA. Unverifiable comparison is REVIEW, not PASS.
fail_conditions: source thin support becomes thick bed
hard_shape_reconstruction_gate.renderer_limit: Policy and acceptance enforcement do not imply hard geometric control within a generative renderer. Disclose unsupported geometry-control capability; never claim pixel/3D identity based on prompt or hashes.

locked_finish_binding.mandatory_for: Every explicitly Champagne Rose earring, all required presentations
locked_finish_binding.execution_precondition: All applicable structural gates pass; source-bound metal surface map exists; demonstrated safe appearance-only operation. Do not edit uncertain structure.
evidence_required: surface map and exact editable-mask SHA256
finish profile revision and canonical hash

finish_consistency_check.authority: locked profile rev1.2.0 and canonical visual reference
finish_consistency_check.pass_requires: Actual applied finish and evidence for every applicable criterion, both views; no inferred PASS from binding metadata. Unknown/unperformed remains NOT_RUN or REVIEW and cannot release.
finish_consistency_check.fail_action: Withhold image; appearance-only correction within budget. Never regenerate or repair geometry to fix finish.
finish_consistency_check.numeric_tolerance_policy: Do not invent universal numeric tolerances; descriptive reference samples are not acceptance thresholds.
finish_consistency_check.gate_f_relationship: Gate F must also pass; this explicit check adds release enforcement, does not erase existing Gate F.

requires: Gate M PASS or justified not-required
user_facing_release.failure_output: Concise exact blocker; no misleading pseudo-final image

retry_policy.img5684_current_authorization: Exactly one controlled structure correction now; no additional retry
retry_policy.insufficient_source: Zero renderer calls and no retry; patch does not reset spent budget.
